title: Forward worker logs with per-worker identifiers
description: Forward worker stdout/stderr to serve stdout/stderr while tagging each line with worker id; JSON logs should be augmented with worker_id field, non-JSON prefixed.

title: Forward worker output with per-line tagging
description:
## Context
Add worker stdout/stderr forwarding in the serve command, tagging each line with a worker id and injecting worker_id into JSON logs.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - add output callback, per-worker per-stream buffers, line splitting, and forwarding.

## Patterns to Follow
- Follow supervision loop and worker lifecycle in `src/Command/ServeCommand.php`.
- Use JSON log patterns from `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] JSON log lines include `extra.worker_id` and preserve existing fields.
- [ ] Non-JSON lines are prefixed with `[worker N] ` and forwarded to correct stream.
- [ ] Ordering is preserved per worker stream.
- [ ] Tests pass: `vendor/bin/phpunit`.

## References

- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-0c5/research.md`

title: Add messenger worker manager with restart policy and E2E coverage
description: Add a manager that spawns multiple Symfony Messenger workers with expected/unexpected restart logic, graceful SIGTERM handling, and end-to-end tests for restart/shutdown scenarios.

title: Supervisor core + command behavior
description:
## Context
Implement the core pm:serve supervisor loop that spawns and manages multiple Messenger workers, applies restart/backoff policy, and handles SIGTERM for graceful shutdown.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - replace stub with supervisor loop, worker tracking, restart policies, and SIGTERM forwarding.
- `src/Resources/config/services.yaml` - keep command registration (no new services unless needed).

## Patterns to Follow
- Use `Symfony\\Component\\Process\\Process` for spawning and managing child processes (see `tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:37`).
- All output must go through logger (JSON stdout only); avoid direct stdout writes to keep E2E log parsing intact (`tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:95`).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Workers spawn and are tracked with restart behavior.
- [ ] Expected exit (code 0) restarts immediately without limit.
- [ ] Unexpected exit applies exponential backoff and stops after retry limit in window.
- [ ] SIGTERM stops respawns, forwards SIGTERM to workers, exits after workers stop.
- [ ] No stdout output besides JSON logger lines.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: Messenger dependency + fixture wiring
description:
## Context
Add Messenger and Process as runtime dependencies and configure the fixture Symfony app so E2E tests can run real Messenger workers.

## Key Changes
- `composer.json` - add `symfony/messenger` to `require`; move `symfony/process` to `require`.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/config/packages/framework.yaml` - enable Messenger with test transport and `stop_worker_on_signals`.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/src` - add message class, handler, and a console command to dispatch the message for tests.

## Patterns to Follow
- Keep fixture app minimal; use existing fixture config style (`tests/Fixtures/app/config/services.yaml`).
- Logger must remain JSON stdout only (see `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php:13`).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Composer dependencies updated for runtime Messenger usage.
- [ ] Fixture Messenger config loads without warnings.
- [ ] Console command can dispatch a test message for worker consumption.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: End-to-end tests
description:
## Context
Add E2E tests for pm:serve supervision behavior and extend the test harness timeout to cover backoff scenarios.

## Key Changes
- `tests/E2E/ProcessCommandTest.php` - expand to include expected exit restarts, unexpected exit backoff/limit, kill + restart, and graceful shutdown.
- `tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php` - increase `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` to accommodate backoff.
- `tests/E2E` - add additional test file if needed for isolation.

## Patterns to Follow
- Use JSON log parsing and no stdout output assumptions (`tests/Support/ConsoleProcessRunner.php:78`).
- Keep tests deterministic; prefer explicit waits and bounded timeouts.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Tests cover expected exit restart, unexpected exit backoff/limit, kill + restart, SIGTERM shutdown.
- [ ] Updated timeout prevents flakiness while staying reasonable.
- [ ] PHPUnit passes.

## References
- Full plan: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/plan.md`
- Research: `.beads/artifacts/SymfonyProcessManager-3cc/research.md`

title: Bundle command + fixture logger wiring
description:
## Context
Add the bundle `pm:serve` command and wire it via bundle DI. In the fixture app, override `Psr\Log\LoggerInterface` with a lightweight stdout JSON logger and import fixture services.

## Key Changes
- `src/Command/ServeCommand.php` - implement `pm:serve` command (no args) and log via LoggerInterface only.
- `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php` - load bundle services config.
- `src/Resources/config/services.yaml` - register command with `console.command` tag.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/src/StdoutJsonLogger.php` - lightweight stdout JSON logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/config/services.yaml` - override LoggerInterface to use the fixture logger.
- `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php` - import `config/services.yaml`.

## Patterns to Follow
- Bundle extension load is currently empty: `src/DependencyInjection/SymfonyProcessManagerExtension.php`.
- Fixture kernel imports only packages: `tests/Fixtures/app/Kernel.php`.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] `php tests/Fixtures/app/bin/console pm:serve` outputs only JSON log lines.
- [ ] No direct console output (only logger output).
